title: Downstream state after a GitOps revert of generate and delete policies
required_authorization: Separate explicit environment and experiment authorization; no automated provisioning is included
preconditions: Disposable cluster with a GitOps reconciler owning the policies
One data-source GeneratingPolicy with sync, one clone-source policy, one DeletingPolicy
procedure: Revert the policy commit and let the reconciler prune
acceptance: Data-source downstream deleted (orphan off); clone downstream retained; deleted objects remain deleted
Restoration happens only through the separate restore plan
capture: Pinned Kubernetes, Kyverno controller and CLI versions with image digests
Sanitized before/after objects and admission responses
Timestamps and the target cluster identity
stop_conditions: Unexpected deletion outside the test namespace
cleanup: Delete only the disposable cluster or the named test namespaces; verify teardown.
